notes.title: Frost Bite Foods Update + Tutorial Improvements
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683557/c75d77f290b22082e5a5314920c1fac53640b893.png"]Checkout Blitz just got an update!
Here’s what’s new:

🎵 New music track added to the soundtrack

🧊 New store level: Frost Bite Foods

✅ Tutorial/first run no longer requires beating a boss

🐛 Various fixes and balancing tweaks:
• Spawn issues
• Pause menu bugs
• Death animation state
• Power-up spawn balance
• RNG improvements

Thanks to everyone for playing and sharing feedback — it helps me make the game better every day!
